recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球的核只分成兩個對稱圓形葉，中間以細絲相連，像夾鼻眼鏡（pince-nez）；染色質濃縮結塊、細胞質顆粒正常，是 Pelger-Huët 異常的經典雙葉核。
features: Neutrophil with a symmetric bilobed nucleus forming a spectacle (pince-nez) configuration
Two round lobes joined by a thin chromatin strand
Pale cytoplasm with normal fine neutrophilic granules
Background normochromic red cells with an echinocyte
describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a symmetric bilobed nucleus composed of two round lobes connected by a thin filament, producing the pince-nez appearance. The chromatin is densely clumped and the cytoplasm shows normal neutrophilic granulation without hypogranularity. Background red cells are normochromic with an occasional echinocyte. Findings are consistent with a Pelger-Huët-type neutrophil; the inherited anomaly is favored when nearly all neutrophils are affected in an otherwise healthy patient.

ddx.vs: Acquired pseudo-Pelger cells in MDS or drug exposure involve a minority of neutrophils and often show hypogranular cytoplasm and other dysplasia.
Eosinophils also have bilobed nuclei but are packed with large refractile orange-red granules.
An occasional normal bilobed neutrophil has elongated, non-symmetric lobes, whereas Pelger cells show round symmetric lobes throughout the population.
